title: Marketing copy polish from the 2026-10-19 scan: the pricing FAQ stops repeating the seat line and names Network on Vera, /spaces says where selling starts, the home H1 reads as two sentences, a directory card shows a Space's kind once, and the sign-in title is sentence case

source.ref: Full scan 2026-10-19 (/mnt/project-files/scan/2026-10-19-full-scan/marketing-and-mobile-detail.md P2 8, P3 12, 16, 17, 20). Owner ruling 2026-10-19: fan out and build everything.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19. PREMISE RE-TESTED on main: of the scan's P3 copy items, the Networks nav link, the Non Profit spelling, the "No add-on menu" clause, "once payouts are ready" and the beta date were already fixed by earlier PRs; this row carries what was still live. The seats FAQ said "Your own seat is included on every plan" twice (the FAQ and seats.detail); the Vera FAQ said only Collective includes it while the table shows Network included; the /spaces "What does it cost?" answer never named a paid plan; the home H1's two sides rendered with no space between them, so crawlers read one run-on sentence; a directory card showed the Space's kind in the where line and again as the pill; the sign-in title was Title Case. Still open for the owner: the Network trial line on /pricing (scan P3 21) and whether Non Profit Collective is retired (scan P2 7).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const faq=r('app/(marketing)/pricing/pricing-faq.ts');if(/Your own seat is included on every plan\\. \\$\\{seats/.test(faq))miss.push('the seats FAQ repeats the seat line');if(!/Collective and Network include it/.test(faq))miss.push('the Vera FAQ leaves out Network');if(!/takes Network/.test(r('components/frequency/site/pages/spaces/frequency-spaces.tsx')))miss.push('/spaces cost answer names no plan');if(!/className=\"p-only\">\\{p\\}<\\/span>\\{' '\\}/.test(r('components/frequency/site/pages/home/frequency-home.tsx')))miss.push('home H1 sides run together');const d=r('components/frequency/site/pages/shared/data.ts');if(!/hasUpcoming \\? s\\.kindLabel : null/.test(d))miss.push('directory card shows the kind twice');if(!/title: 'Sign in'/.test(r('app/sign-in/page.tsx')))miss.push('sign-in title is Title Case');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-991: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
